judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— The learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the Erode Corporation would submit that the subject encroachments have already been removed and therefore, the cause does not survive.

2. Recording the submission of the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the Erode Corporation, the present Writ Petitions are closed. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
